sections.heading: Stephanie McMahon — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Stephanie McMahon was born on 24 September 1976 in Hartford, and holds American nationality. She was given the name Stephanie Marie McMahon at birth and is publicly known as Stephanie McMahon.
Public records name her father, Vince McMahon and her mother, Linda McMahon. She is a sibling of Shane McMahon.
She received her education at Boston University, Boston University College of Communication, Greenwich High School and Greenwich Country Day School.
She is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: Stephanie McMahon — Career and Professional Work
paras: Stephanie McMahon works primarily as a professional wrestler, businessperson, actor and professional wrestling writer, with WWE listed among her employers.
She has held the following offices: chief brand officer (2015–2023). She is affiliated with Republican Party.
